AUDIO.title: I2S isolation buffer
wiring_notes: Place U801 upright and use short named stubs for the physical-order logic pins.
Connect C801 directly between a local MIC_3V3 rail and local GND rail; no across-page supply bus.
Tie OE pins by named AUDIO_OE_N stubs if a local bus would cross signal pins.

AUDIO.title: Audio-enable inversion
wiring_notes: AUDIO_EN input left, AUDIO_OE_N output right, local MIC_3V3 / GND and C806.
U805 pin 1 is intentionally NC.

AUDIO.title: Bit clock series and pull-down
wiring_notes: AUDIO_BCLK_BUF -> R808 22R -> I2S_BCLK_AUDIO. R802 100k branches from output node down to GND.

AUDIO.title: Word select series and pull-down
wiring_notes: AUDIO_WS_BUF -> R809 22R -> I2S_WS_AUDIO. R803 100k branches from output node down to GND.

AUDIO.title: Speaker data series and pull-down
wiring_notes: AUDIO_DIN_BUF -> R810 22R -> I2S_DIN_AUDIO. R804 100k branches from output node down to GND.

AUDIO.title: Amplifier enable mode bias
wiring_notes: AUDIO_SD_BUF -> R806 2.00k -> AMP_SD_MODE. R805 100k branches down from AMP_SD_MODE to GND.

AUDIO.title: Class D amplifier and speaker
wiring_notes: U802 OUTP and OUTN pass through separate R811/R812 0R links directly to J801 pins 1/2. Keep these as two parallel paths, not GND referenced.
C802 and C803 share short local AMP_SYS / GND rails.
I2S_BCLK_AUDIO, I2S_WS_AUDIO, I2S_DIN_AUDIO and AMP_SD_MODE are labelled block inputs.
U802 pins 5,6,12,13 are intentionally NC; exposed pad 17 belongs to GND.

AUDIO.title: I2S microphone
wiring_notes: Connect MIC_SD_RAW output directly to R813 pull-down; label its continuation to A6.
C804/C805 connect in parallel across local MIC_3V3 and GND rails.
I2S_WS_AUDIO and I2S_BCLK_AUDIO are labelled block inputs; U803 pins 1,2,4 are GND.

AUDIO.title: Microphone always-on-domain return
wiring_notes: MIC_SD_RAW -> U804 -> MIC_DATA, with OE pin 1 and pin 3 to local GND.
C808 decouples 3V3_AON, not MIC_3V3.

CHARGE_TEMP.title: NTC bias and filtering
wiring_notes: VIN_5V -> R901 47k -> BAT_NTC node, C902 10n from BAT_NTC to GND.
BAT_NTC comes from external battery connector; no temperature substitution or fixed thermistor added.

CHARGE_TEMP.title: Hot threshold divider
wiring_notes: VIN_5V -> R902 100k -> NTC_HOT_REF -> R903 12k -> GND.
C903 10n parallel to R903; use one visible branch junction.

CHARGE_TEMP.title: Cold threshold divider
wiring_notes: VIN_5V -> R904 100k -> NTC_COLD_REF -> R905 33k -> GND.
C904 10n parallel to R905; use one visible branch junction.

CHARGE_TEMP.title: Window comparators and charger TS output
wiring_notes: Keep U901.1 and U901.2 vertically aligned as two logical units of one physical U901.
Unit 1: pin 2 NTC_HOT_REF, pin 3 BAT_NTC, output pin 1 CHG_TS. Unit 2: pin 5 NTC_COLD_REF, pin 6 BAT_NTC, output pin 7 CHG_TS.
Directly join the two open-drain outputs on a single right-side CHG_TS bus.
R906 10k goes from CHG_TS to GND. R907 330k goes CHG_TS to BAT_NTC. R908 330k goes CHG_TS to NTC_COLD_REF. These are not GND pull-downs; label the remote ends distinctly.
C901 decouples U901 pins 8 VIN_5V / 4 GND. Keep this supply local to the comparator block.

general: Do not use a page-wide GND or power rail.
Within each small block use direct orthogonal wires; cross-block signals use labels.
Do not infer pin positions or rotate parts from KiCad geometry; read actual native pin positions first.
Preserve all values and nets; this plan is presentation only.
